LESS SEARCHING. MORE WATCHING.

Found a programme?
Save it for tonight.

Search channels and programmes in one source or across all of them. Find what’s live, coming up or available in catch-up.

Hold ↓ while watching → Search → OK. Enter a title using the remote-friendly on-screen keyboard or a physical keyboard.

Press OK on a programme result → Add bookmark. Return to it in the top panel’s Bookmarks tab: hold ↑.

Programme search uses the downloaded guide. Programme bookmarks require a catch-up channel; viewing availability depends on your provider.

01 / PICTURE IN PICTURE

Two things to watch.
One evening to enjoy.

Turn on PiP: your current channel moves to the small window and the previous channel opens in the main view. Follow the match, return to your film and swap windows whenever you like.

  • 01Two TV channels at once
  • 02Live TV, catch-up and your videos — in the main window or PiP
  • 03Move with the arrow keys. Set the width from 10 to 75% of the screen

Settings → Interface → PiP. Move the window in 5% screen steps with the arrow keys. The default width is 25%; adjust it with left/right. OK saves; Back cancels.

ALL IN ONE PLAYER

From your first channel
to your everyday favourites.

A complete feature overview. Open a section to explore the details.

01Sources and your collection
  • M3U by URL or file, plus Xtream Codes connections; keep multiple sources in one app.
  • Categories, favourites, viewing history, and search for channels and programmes.
  • My Playlist brings selected channels from different sources together. Create and rename groups, reorder channels, move them or remove them from your collection.
  • For each source: on launch, daily, weekly or manually. Updates are checked when opening or returning to the app, without a background timer.
02TV guide and catch-up
  • XMLTV, including gzip. Each source’s EPG can refresh on launch, daily, weekly or manually, with an optional refresh after channel updates.
  • A three-hour guide with arrow-key navigation between programmes, descriptions and a programme list for the selected channel.
  • Catch-up programmes, time selection, pause and seeking. Pause live TV and resume through catch-up when supported by the provider.
  • Turn off automatic EPG updates for each source while keeping manual refresh available. Disabling updates cancels the corresponding jobs and retries.
03Playback and two-window PiP
  • Open live TV, catch-up or local video in the main window or PiP. Swap windows, hide or close PiP; audio comes from the main window.
  • Adjust PiP position and size with your remote: 5% steps, a default width of 25%, and a 10–75% range.
  • Automatic selection of a lighter video variant when playback struggles and one is available. If resources run short, PiP can close to help restore the main view.
  • When PiP opens, the current channel moves to the small window and the previous channel becomes the main view. Without a previous channel, PiP shows a copy of the current one.
04Live recording and your videos
  • Start recording manually or schedule a future programme from the guide or programme list. One channel can be recorded independently of what you watch.
  • Movies/GlassIPTV is the default folder; choose another accessible folder, including USB storage. The library lists recordings and other video files found there.
  • Pause, seeking that accelerates while a key is held, tracks and subtitles. Deleting a recording from the library also deletes its file.
  • Manual stops and scheduled endings finalise recordings. Recording supports direct MPEG-TS and unencrypted HLS with TS segments.
05Reminders, schedules and bookmarks
  • Create reminders and scheduled recordings from the guide or programme panel. Reminders appear in the centre of the screen, or as notifications in the background.
  • Recordings, reminders, scheduled recordings and bookmarks share four tabs in the top panel. Left/right arrows change tabs without moving focus to a tab heading.
  • Delete reminders and cancel future recordings; expired reminders are removed automatically. Background tasks need an available stream, storage and the relevant Android permissions.
  • Scheduled recording starts 30 seconds before the programme and ends at its EPG end time. Conflict checks include this lead-in; one channel can be recorded at a time.
  • Bookmark moments from live TV and catch-up using the toolbar. Open or delete them in the Bookmarks tab; archive availability and PIN protection are checked when opening.
06Remote, phone and interface
  • Press OK to watch; hold OK for actions and window selection. Hold Up for recordings and plans, or Down for tools.
  • Enter a channel number and switch sources from the same panel; return to the previous view, including video files.
  • Five presets and a custom theme: panel, text and selection colours, plus focus border width. Preview, save or cancel. Transparency and scale remain under Interface.
  • D-pad navigation on TV; touch and text pasting enabled by default on phones. The on-screen remote remains available. D-pad-only mode is available in hidden settings.
07Audio, subtitles and picture
  • Choose audio tracks, subtitles and picture aspect ratio. Select system or software audio decoding manually.
  • Support for specific video formats, UHD and two simultaneous streams depends on the device, decoder and source.
08Parental controls
  • Protect a channel or category by holding OK. Changing protection requires a PIN even if viewing is already unlocked.
  • The initial PIN is 0000. Changing it in Settings requires the current code. After verification, unlock one channel or all protected channels for the session.
  • Access checks also apply when opening PiP. Adult content is not detected automatically, and third-party video files are not classified.
09Diagnostics when you need them
  • Diagnostics are available in hidden settings. Off by default; enable it to investigate an issue, then turn it off. Your choice is saved.
  • Logs in Download/GlassIPTV include player events, quality variants and decoder errors. Stream addresses and PINs are not recorded.
  • Bounded logs and batched background writes. Turning diagnostics off finishes the final export and stops the logging worker.

Before your first viewing

Do I need a channel subscription?

The app does not sell or provide channels. You need an M3U playlist or Xtream Codes account. Access terms, programme information and catch-up depend on your source.

Which devices can I use?

Android TV, Google TV and phones with Android 8.0+. Phones support touch, address pasting and an on-screen remote in landscape. Format support depends on the device and decoder.

What do PiP, UHD and live pause need?

For two TV channels, your source must allow simultaneous connections and your device must decode two streams. Combine live TV, catch-up and local video. The player can switch to lighter variants when available; it cannot turn a single UHD stream into HD. Two UHD streams are not guaranteed on every TV box. Live pause requires provider catch-up support.

How do scheduled recordings work?

Choose a future programme in the guide or programme list. Recording starts 30 seconds before it begins and ends at its EPG end time. Android 12+ may require exact alarm permission. The device must be on, with the stream and folder available. Android background restrictions can affect starting; recording is not guaranteed after force-stopping the app.

Where are recordings saved and which streams are supported?

The default folder is Movies/GlassIPTV. You can choose another accessible folder, including USB. One channel can be recorded at a time. Recording supports direct MPEG-TS and unencrypted HLS with TS segments; playback of your own files depends on format support.
